answer: Skim 25% off the stake at first detection and the farm's 16520 POA shrinks by 25% before the paint dries. Show me a terrace with a history, a lagoon with a receipt, a hollow with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Grist weigher corn toll milled at the millpond is that proof: each corn is a year of millhouse logs in the granary ledger. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. The farm arrived with a hundred keys and left with a hundred rejections; the keys still open nothing.
